survivedEnding: ^My apologies for the misunderstanding. I hear you have a message for me?
^It is a great honor to meet the Commander of the Imperial Forces, let alone a member of the Imperial Family.
^I am Masahiro Inaba, fourth son of the Daimyo of Yodo. The Daimyo of Tsu and Yodo seek to join forces with the Emperor, Your Highness.
^Quite auspicious news. With this, I doubt the Shogun will remain here. I exeepct the imminent capture of this base at Osaka castle
